new_theorem.statement: For a complete physical rank-two cut A[H,I]=P C^T with P^T P=I2, G=C^TC, Delta=sqrt(det G), opposite singleton third-volume aggregates G_I,G_H and no-coloop gates q_I,q_H<1, there exist a physical diagonal D0, a rank-at-most-four carrier S=U K U^T and retained block-diagonal residual E such that A=D0+S+E and ||E||F <= (sqrt(2)/Delta)[G_I/(1-q_I)+G_H/(1-q_H)]^(1/2). At G_I=G_H=0 the representation is exact.
new_theorem.spectral_corollary: If the cut is the whole target matrix, s3(A)>=1, ||D0||op<=tau and the residual bound is eps, then s3(S)>=1-tau-eps; hence tau+eps<1 forces rank S>=3.
